prompt:
GAME BUTTON ICON. One small scene seen from the side and a little above, centred, as an icon on a command button in a top-down strategy game.

Images 1 and 2 are our approved pictures from the same game: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only, not their shapes.

Create an ORIGINAL icon meaning "pull the load out low and let it slide": a flat olive-drab cargo platform with one squarish olive load strapped on it with tan straps, sliding along the ground toward the RIGHT, a small puff of tan dust kicked up behind it on the left. Ahead of it on the right, one small round olive-drab parachute, open and leaning back, its thin pale lines running to the front of the platform, pulling it. A short bold amber arrow along the ground points right, the way it slides. The ground is one thin flat line.

Style: an icon for the game RimWorld: a very thick near-black outline around every shape, bold simple shapes, flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, a muted palette with the amber arrow as the only bright colour, readable when shrunk to 64 pixels. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

Draw ONLY the icon, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about three quarters of the canvas. Square canvas. No aircraft, people, hands, text, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks.
